## What the measurement found

No type meets both removal conditions of R52.

Every declared edge is traversed and has at least one instance.

`superseded_by` is counted apart: 1 reference(s). It is not an edge, its target MUST resolve under R22, and expansion MUST NOT follow it, so R52's traversal criterion does not apply to it. It is reported here so moving it out of the edge table did not also move it out of view.

One measurement over one fixture calibrates nothing on its own. The specification defers the body length ceiling of R48 and the expansion depth of the traversal table to this measurement, and neither should move until more than one knowledge base has been measured.
